title: Answer
description:
Washings, laying on of hands, resurrection, and judgment are already in the earlier word. They are not a foundation to be laid again.

The falling that cannot be renewed to repentance is not ordinary weakness. It is treating the Son as that generation treated God.

To crucify the Son of God again is to take sides against the one offering, in the open.

Ground that drinks the rain and then bears thorns is rejected. The rain is what God gives. The fruit shows whether the word was received.
